level1_releases.name: v2.1.325
level1_releases.body_excerpt:
## What's changed

- Fixed a security issue in how zstd-compressed responses are decoded
- Added a spinner tip in VS Code and similar integrated terminals about re-running a notebook cell, shown once Claude has read or edited a Jupyter notebook
- Added a line under the error shown when your organization's policy blocks a request, saying how to continue: run `/rewind` and change the message, or run `/clear`
- Added a note for Claude when a sandboxed `git checkout`, `git stash` or autostash pull cannot update protected files such as those in `.claude`
- Fixed `/security-review` and skills' inline git commands stopping with an error in worktrees of bare repositories, `--separate-git-dir` checkouts and Android `repo` checkouts
- Fixed subagents with their own model being moved to the plan-mode model when the model setting is `opusplan` or `haiku`
- Fixed subagents on a different model sizing file reads and MCP results with the main session's model
- Fixed sessions on many third-party gateways and Foundry stopping with a context length error on every turn instead of compacting
- Fixed recent turns sometimes going missing from a resumed session after Claude Code stopped without a clean exit
- Fixed shell commands running in the launch directory after the working directory was deleted; the command now fails with a message and can be re-issued
- Fixed an approved plan edit being lost when the `plansDirectory` folder can't take it: the plan is now saved in the default plans folder, and a warning says where and why
- Fixed a saved `sonnet[1m]` model setting being rewritten on a new install to a model id the API rejects
- Fixed focus view hiding the reply to your prompt when a scheduled task replied after it
- Fixed the prompt sometimes missing from a background subagent's view when fullscreen is off
- Fixed long options in lists and permission prompts being partly overwritten when they wrap, and first-run screens losing lines on narrow terminals
- Fixed startup warnings about permission rules and the "N MCP servers need authentication" notice being recorded as seen when they were scrolled out of view
- Fixed the welcome header showing control characters or splitting across lines when an agent's name or the working folder contains them or a line break
- Fixed the red error shown when Claude tries a command only you can run: a dim line now says it runs only when you type it at the prompt
- Fixed `/stats` showing an Active days total that was one day too high
- Fixed `

## New Features

- The opt-in terminal workspace supports multiple side-chat tabs. Switch between them with the keyboard or mouse, and reopen saved local side chats after restarting Codex. (#59784, #60152, #60181)
- Search older tasks from the agent command center by name, prompt preview, or working directory. (#60286)
- Turn on **Collapse turn details** in the full-screen transcript to fold completed activity beneath each prompt while keeping answers visible and tool output searchable. (#60554, #60555, #60556, #60557)
- Add or edit custom model providers from the terminal. With custom gateway onboarding enabled, you can create a provider during sign-in and use a device code for supported gateways over SSH or without a local browser. (#59779, #60009, #60186, #60486, #60662)
- Press `Ctrl+S` in the terminal report editor to save a diagnostic ZIP locally, even when uploads are disabled. (#60542)
- With the opt-in Cloud connection on macOS and Linux, send images, choose a model and reasoning effort, and archive or restore Cloud conversations from the terminal. (#59828, #60061, #60635, #60651)

## Bug Fixes

- `codex exec` keeps project configuration and MCP servers disabled in untrusted directories, even with `--sandbox workspace-write`. Use `--trust` with `codex exec` or `codex review` to explicitly save project trust. (#60041)
- **Yes, clear context and implement** now hands the full approved plan to the fresh session and keeps the current session open if the handoff fails. (#60763)
- Fixed Windows sandbox handling for quoted `cmd.exe` paths and for PowerShell sessions whose working directory has an unreadable parent. (#60624, #60647)
- Pasted images on macOS retain their intended orientation and use native PNG or JPEG clipboard data when available. (#60455)
- The terminal no longer stays busy waiting for MCP servers that a shared app server did not report. (#60280, #60622)
- Interrupted turns now close cleanly, and delayed aborts or file approval cancellations no longer interrupt a later turn. (#59910, #60700)

## Documentation

- Updated the `openai-docs` skill to focus on Codex and ChatGPT Work questions and first-time API setup, with dedicated guidance for configuring Codex across a team. (#59944, #59949)
- Documented how app-server clients can list models or authorize a gateway for a configured provider without changing the default provider. (#59776, #59819)

## Chores

- Updated bundled SQLite to 3.54 to pick up write-ahead log fixes. (#60432)
- Plugi
